text:
alex: Quick one — we need to agree what gets trimmed from MVP for the May launch. Q: can we keep the new multi-tenant routing or move it to v1?

maria: multi-tenant routing is risky for this cycle, still flaky under p95 load. suggest move to v1.

jamal: +1. Also the new alignment UI has a lot of unknowns on performance. can we freeze it for now?

alex: OK. Proposal: keep core inference API, embeddings, streaming, and rollout policies. Cut alignment UI and multi-tenant routing to v1. Move SSO tenant onboarding to v1 unless a paying customer needs it before launch.

sophie: For telemetry, we must keep token-level cost breakdown — it's an async dashboard but critical for GA customers. can we keep it scoped down (90 day window instead of full historical)?

benji: We can scope telemetry to 90d and disable some heavy aggregation endpoints. engineering estimate ~2w saved.

cs-team: Customer ask from ACME: needs tenant SSO + data isolation for pilot. if we cut SSO they might delay pilot.

alex: noted. Two options: (A) small pilot carveout for ACME (partner path) with manual provisioning and limited SLA; (B) hold launch and add SSO. I prefer A to keep overall launch date.

maria: manual provisioning for 1-2 pilots is doable but needs clear security checklist + postmortem plan.

jamal: tech plan for A: add an admin-only onboarding flow, flag behind `pilot_sso` feature flag. ops can handle keys. estimate 3d + docs.

alex: sounds reasonable. Decision draft: Cut alignment UI and multi-tenant routing from MVP -> v1. Keep telemetry (90d) and core API. Offer partner carveout (manual SSO) for 1-2 pilot customers.

sophie: agree. please add acceptance criteria for the carveout: checklist, runbook, and rollback criteria.

benji: will own telemetry scope-down. i'll add the PR with TODOs and telemetry feature flags.

alex: jamal — can you own the pilot_sso flag implementation? target branch by EOD Friday?

jamal: yep, radar set. will post a short RFC in eng-platform channel with the flag design.

pm-bot: Reminder: roadmap freeze scheduled for 2005500000 (one week). Please finalize cuts by EOD Thursday.

alex: final ask — product to publish trimmed MVP list + owner assignments in the milestone doc. i'll update the milestone sheet after this thread.

cs-team: i'll coordinate ACME pilot comms and confirm whether they accept manual carveout.

alex: thanks everyone. summarize action items: 1) alex publish trimmed-MVP in milestone doc, 2) benji scope-down telemetry (owner: benji), 3) jamal implement `pilot_sso` flag (owner: jamal), 4) sophie create carveout acceptance criteria (owner: sophie), 5) cs-team confirm ACME pilot. target: EOD Thursday. :thumbsup:

benji: noted and will open PR for telemetry changes today.

jamal: RFC pinged to eng-platform in 10m.

sophie: will drop acceptance checklist into milestone doc by tomorrow.

alex: closing thread — if anyone has major objections, flag here within 24h. otherwise we'll lock the cut list and proceed. :lock:
